shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: The pop-up panel, the only lifted surface.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action on a band: ink fill, gentle corners.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1D1C1A; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, #1D1C1A 88%, #FBFAF8); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1D1C1A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The quieter second action: an ink outline.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #1D1C1A; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid #1D1C1A; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F1EFEA; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1D1C1A; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The preset every site falls back to when it has no theme of its own, or when its theme cannot be read. It is deliberately nobody's brand, including CDS's: an off-white page, near black ink, the device's own sans-serif, and a single rust accent. Its job is to be legible and to get out of the way.
keyCharacteristics: Off-white page, near-black ink; the ink doubles as the button colour.
The system sans-serif in both roles; zero font downloads.
Gentle 4px corners on buttons and images.
One rust accent for hero accent words and countdown numerals.

rules.name: The No Brand Rule
rules.body: The preset carries no identity. Never add a logo colour, a signature font or a flourish to it; a site that wants character gets its own theme.

dos: Do keep the preset exactly in step with the platform's built-in fallback values.
Do keep every text pair at or above 4.5:1 and the accent at or above 3:1.
donts: Don't add a web font to the preset; it must download nothing.
Don't give the preset a brand colour, logo tone or named identity.
